cli-usage:actions.reason: The existing 0.4.0 action CLI adds this usage row while preserving every 0.3.12 invocation.

0.4.2 adds -V beside --version and a --help or -h that prints this usage on stdout with status 0. In 0.3.12 --help was an unknown flag and any word with one leading dash, -h and -V included, opened as a start folder; 0.4.2 reads -h and -V as these flags and refuses every other dash-led word, so those answers change on purpose. Usage errors gain these two rows, and every other 0.3.12 row keeps its bytes.
